reference_corpus.text: Start by instrumenting the request path end to end before adding custom metrics.
Sampling is the main lever teams have on observability spend.
Alert on symptoms your users feel, not on every resource threshold.

inputs.goal: the 'observability for small teams' brief, for platform engineers

intake.summary: Focus on instrumenting request paths end to end first. This gives visibility into user experience before adding custom metrics. Control costs through sampling - it's your primary tool for managing observability spend. Set alerts on user symptoms, not resource thresholds. This approach keeps on-call responsibilities manageable and ensures you measure what matters most to users.

outline.claim: Instrument the complete request path first to understand user experience before adding custom metrics

outline.claim: Sampling is the primary method for managing observability expenses
outline.evidence: Reference r2 states 'Sampling is the main lever teams have on observability spend.'

outline.section: Set Meaningful Alerts on User Symptoms
outline.claim: Alert on user-facing symptoms rather than resource thresholds to maintain manageable on-call responsibilities
outline.evidence: Reference r3 states 'Alert on symptoms your users feel, not on every resource threshold.'
